Welcome to Sugarland Animal Hospital –Caring for the Pets of Bundaberg.

At Sugarland Animal Hospital we pride ourselves on providing the best in Veterinary care.

We know that when you are looking for vets in the Bundaberg area that you want all the professionalism and expertise that you would expect from a vet but at the same time providing Quality Customer service and care for your loved pets. As vets it’s always tempting to talk about our credentials and years of experience. And while we know that is important to you, let’s be frank – what’s most important to you is NOT our qualifications. What’s important is knowing 3 things that:

    Your pet will be nurtured in our care
    We recognize your needs and expectations
    We’ll do our utmost to ensure your pet is healthy and happy

As pet lovers ourselves, it’s the little things we do for you and your pet that demonstrate we care.
- See more at: http://sugarlandvet.com/
